Host safety (fleet-v1):
- Do not start local database servers. Database integration tests belong in CI.
- Run only tests for what you changed locally; leave full suites to CI.
- Stop every fixture or background process you start, by its PID, before finishing.
- Work only in a worktree, never in the canonical checkout.
- Report READY, ESC and other notices to operator-desk or a claude parent lane only with `panewire emit --kind lane.event`; never inject into that pane with herdr prompt/send-text/send-keys. If you cannot see the receiver, emit rc 0 is enough; do not raise an ESC about delivery. A codex/grok/devin parent keeps the ops skill's escalation route (emit, then a verified herdr prompt).
